title: Sandisk to pay Kioxia $1.165B to extend flash joint venture to 2034

sources.quote: As part of this renewed agreement, Sandisk will pay Kioxia USD 1.165 billion for manufacturing services and continued availability of supply.
As part of this renewed agreement, Sandisk will pay Kioxia USD 1.165 billion for manufacturing services and continued availability of supply.

explain: Sandisk and Kioxia make flash memory together in Japanese factories. To keep that arrangement going through 2034, Sandisk will pay Kioxia $1.165 billion in installments from 2026 to 2029 for manufacturing services and guaranteed access to supply.
